# Hermes Agent config for one headless trial on a Particle cell (HARN-16).
# Copied to $HERMES_HOME/config.yaml (under /harness-state) by adapter.sh when
# HE_MODEL_BASE_URL ends in /particle. Particle speaks OpenAI Chat Completions,
# so the model runs on Hermes's custom-endpoint provider (transport
# chat_completions) through the custom_providers entry below; the adapter
# selects it with --provider custom:particle. Secrets are not here: the adapter
# exports OPENAI_API_KEY (the per-trial proxy token) and OPENAI_BASE_URL (the
# proxy plus /v1), which Hermes expands into this file at load time. On a
# custom endpoint Hermes sends no reasoning field and no output cap of its own,
# so extra_body adds both to every request: reasoning_effort medium, the value
# every harness on the cell sends (Particle serves medium at its high tier),
# and max_completion_tokens 128000, the cap the OpenAI cells run under, because
# Particle spends output on reasoning_content before any visible text.
# Everything else is as in config.yaml.
_config_version: 46

model:
  provider: "custom:particle"
  default: "particle-1"
  base_url: "${OPENAI_BASE_URL}"
  # Particle-1's window (docs.particle.ai/models), as the OpenClaw and QM Particle configs declare it. Without it Hermes asks
  # the endpoint's /models and falls back to 256,000 (agent/model_metadata.py), so it would compress at a quarter of the window.
  context_length: 1048576

custom_providers:
  - name: "particle"
    base_url: "${OPENAI_BASE_URL}"
    key_env: "OPENAI_API_KEY"
    extra_body:
      reasoning_effort: "medium"
      max_completion_tokens: 128000

terminal:
  backend: "local"
  cwd: "/workspace"
  timeout: 180
  home_mode: "profile"

display:
  streaming: false

# Nothing that needs a person: no update checks, no telemetry prompts.
auto_update: false
check_for_updates: false

# No lazy pip installs at turn time (Bedrock's boto3, edge-tts): the trial
# network has no package index, and no task uses those features (HARN-13).
security:
  allow_lazy_installs: false
mcp_servers:
  gbrain:
    command: /harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain
    args:
      - serve
      - --surface
      - starter
      - --advertise
      - verbs
    env:
      GBRAIN_HOME: /harness-state
    connect_timeout: 60.0
    enabled: true

"""Drive gbrain's stdio MCP server exactly as Hermes will: spawn, initialize, tools/list, call forget/remember/recall."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys

GBRAIN = "/harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain"
env = dict(os.environ)
env["GBRAIN_HOME"] = "/harness-state"

p = subprocess.Popen(
    [GBRAIN, "serve", "--surface", "starter", "--advertise", "verbs"],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, text=True, bufsize=1,
)

next_id = [0]

def send(method, params=None, notify=False):
    msg = {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": method}
    if not notify:
        next_id[0] += 1
        msg["id"] = next_id[0]
    if params is not None:
        msg["params"] = params
    p.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + "\n")
    p.stdin.flush()
    if notify:
        return None
    while True:
        line = p.stdout.readline()
        if not line:
            raise SystemExit("server closed stdout; stderr=" + p.stderr.read())
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            obj = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if obj.get("id") == msg["id"]:
            return obj

init = send("initialize", {
    "protocolVersion": "2024-11-05",
    "capabilities": {},
    "clientInfo": {"name": "hermes-verify", "version": "1.0"},
})
print("initialize ->", json.dumps(init.get("result", init))[:200])
send("notifications/initialized", notify=True)

tools = send("tools/list", {})
names = [t["name"] for t in tools["result"]["tools"]]
print("tools:", names)

def call(name, args):
    r = send("tools/call", {"name": name, "arguments": args})
    res = r.get("result", {})
    content = res.get("content") or []
    text = "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in content if isinstance(c, dict))
    return res.get("isError", False), text

ok, text = call("remember", {
    "fact": "GBrain MCP round-trip marker: mcp-734-cedar-otter written over stdio MCP.",
    "entity": "gbrain-mcp-check",
    "provenance": "install-check",
    "content_origin": "inferred",
})
print("\nremember isError=%s ->" % ok, text[:600])

ok2, text2 = call("recall", {"entity": "gbrain-mcp-check"})
print("\nrecall isError=%s ->" % ok2, text2[:900])
print("\nROUNDTRIP_OK:", ("cedar-otter" in text2) and not ok2)

p.stdin.close()
p.terminate()
